summary: Game crashes when player model is rendered after the player is stung by a bee
description: The bug When getting stung by a bee, the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered. To reproduce There are multiple ways to reproduce this issue: Inventory - Get stung by a bee - Open your inventory Third-person camera - Enable third-person camera - Get stung by a bee Crash report 19w39a : [^crash-2019-09-27_13.19.08-client.txt] Description: Rendering entity in world java.lang.IllegalStateException: Not filled all elements of the vertex at cxk.a(SourceFile:253) at dwx.a(SourceFile:56) at dyd.a(SourceFile:48) at dyd.a(SourceFile:14) at duw.a(SourceFile:138) at dym.a(SourceFile:64) at dym.a(SourceFile:41) at dtz.a(SourceFile:268) at dtz.a(SourceFile:253) at dgt.a(SourceFile:134) at dgt.a(SourceFile:106) at dfx.render(SourceFile:82) at dgm.render(SourceFile:42) at dgt.render(SourceFile:86) at dpo.a(SourceFile:603) at dat.d(SourceFile:931) at dat.b(SourceFile:569) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Use `/summon minecraft:bee ~ ~ ~` to summon a bee at your location.
3. Approach the bee and get stung by it.
4. Open your inventory immediately after getting stung.
5. Observe that the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered.

---

1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Use `/summon minecraft:bee ~ ~ ~` to summon a bee at your location.
3. Enable third-person camera by pressing F5.
4. Approach the bee and get stung by it.
5. Observe that the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered.
Observed Behavior: When a player is stung by a bee, the game crashes immediately upon rendering the player model. This issue can be reproduced in multiple ways: by getting stung while opening the inventory or enabling the third-person camera before being stung. The crash report from version 19w39a indicates an error related to entity rendering, specifically a `java.lang.IllegalStateException` stating that not all elements of the vertex were filled at `cxk.a(SourceFile:253)`. This leads to subsequent errors in various source files as the game attempts to render the player model. The crash provides detailed stack traces from different parts of the codebase, highlighting issues within rendering functions and entity handling mechanisms.
Expected Behavior: When a player is stung by a bee, the game should continue normally without crashing. The player model should render correctly whether the inventory is opened or the third-person camera is enabled after being stung. The game should not crash under these conditions, and the player should be able to interact with the environment as usual.
